aboutWhatItDoes: HealthYarn dey allow you ask health question for Yorùbá, Nigerian Pidgin, or English and hear confirmed general health advice with Nigerian voice. E no dey use AI cook up new medical answer.
aboutWhatItDoesNot: HealthYarn no dey diagnose sickness, prescribe medicine, or calculate personal dose. For any emergency or danger sign, go hospital straight.
aboutPrivacySummary: No account for public users. No tracking cookies. Voice recording dey stay only for RAM sharp-sharp and e dey delete immediately.
sttFailedMessage: I no hear your voice clear right now. Abeg check any topic wey dey under or try again.
primaryTagline: Your health, for your own language.
heroEyebrow: Make we yarn about your health
heroHeadline: Ask for your own language. Hear answer wey you fit trust.
heroSubheadline: HealthYarn dey answer health question with voice, for Yoruba, Pidgin or English. You no need read, you no need type. Health worker don check every answer.
heroReadAloudLabel: Listen to this intro out loud
trustDemo: Demo content, e still dey under review
trustVoice: We no dey save your voice
trustData: E dey work with small data
mockupQuestion: How I go mix ORS for running stomach?
topicOrs: Running stomach for pikin and ORS
problemHeading: Health advice no suppose need big English.
problemBody: Doctors no plenty and dem dey busy well-well. Paper and medicine pack dey always carry English. So many people dey wait too long, take drug wrong way, or follow wetin neighbour talk. HealthYarn give everybody person wey dem fit ask.
stat2Label: adults no sabi read well (adult literacy 62%)
stat3Label: na common time to wait see doctor
step1Body: Press Yoruba, Pidgin or English. The app go talk guide you.
step2Body: Hold the mic talk your question, like "My pikin dey stool since yesterday. Wetin I go do?" Or just press picture.
step3Body: Nigerian voice go answer you for your language. You fit play am again or slow am down anytime.
safetyBody: HealthYarn no dey form medical advice by itself. Every answer come from World Health Organization and Federal Ministry of Health guide, health worker check am, translate am, and person wey sabi the language check am again. If e no sure wetin you ask, e go tell you true.
safetyBodyUnreviewed: For dis preview version, the voice guide dey work well while health worker and language review still dey under final check.
safetyWill1: explain common sickness with simple words
safetyWill2: tell you when to run go clinic sharp-sharp
safetyWill3: show you how to take drug safely
safetyWillNot1: check your body or talk which sickness you get
safetyWillNot2: write drug or dose for you
safetyWillNot3: replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist
dangerCalloutBody: If wetin you talk sound serious, HealthYarn go stop tell you make you go clinic now-now, and e go show you clinics near you.
topicsBandHeading: Wetin you fit ask about today.
topicsMore: More health topics still dey come.
languagesBody: Na Spitch we use build the voices for Nigerian languages. Press make you hear the same answer for each language.
privacyHeading: Wetin you talk dey stay with you.
privacyPoint1Body: No sign-up, no name, no phone number.
privacyPoint2Body: We only use your voice understand your question, then e delete sharp-sharp.
privacyPoint3Body: We only count which topic people dey ask about, so we fit make am better.
partnersHeading: You dey work for clinic, chemist or community programme?
partnersBody: Use HealthYarn explain things to people for their own language, or join us check and add new answers.
faq1A: No. E dey give general health info wey health workers don check. E no dey check body or diagnose sickness. If body dey do you bad-bad, go clinic.
faq2A: E free to use. E dey use small data, and answers wey you don hear before dey work even without internet.
faq3Q: I need sabi read or type?
faq3A: No. You fit do everything by talking, listening and pressing pictures.
faq4A: No. Your voice recording dey help us understand wetin you ask, then e go delete immediately.
faq5A: Yoruba, Nigerian Pidgin and English. More dey come.
faq6Q: If e no understand wetin I talk nko?
faq6A: E go tell you, and e go show you few questions make you pick. E no dey guess.
closingHeading: Make we yarn about your health.
closingSub: Ask your first question now. E go take ten seconds.
footerDisclaimer: HealthYarn dey give general health information only. E no dey replace doctor, nurse or pharmacist. For emergency, go nearest hospital or clinic sharp-sharp.
footerCredits: Voices by Spitch. Built for the NCS IT Development Contest 2026.
